1	# Epic 1 Context: Foundation & Session Management
2	
3	<!-- Compiled from planning artifacts. Edit freely. Regenerate with compile-epic-context if planning docs change. -->
4	
5	## Goal
6	
7	This epic delivers the scaffold every other feature depends on: the pinned-stack project setup with its core infrastructure verified working together, the full visual design-token system, email/password authentication with silent session refresh, the session-expiry recovery overlay, and a base navigation shell with placeholders for everything not yet built. It is delivered first because every later epic assumes this foundation — DI, networking, error handling, session state, design tokens, and navigation — already exists and is stable. Users come away able to create an account, log in, stay logged in across restarts, recover gracefully if their session expires mid-use, and navigate the whole app shell even though most feature screens are still placeholders.
8	
9	## Stories
10	
11	- Story 1.1: Project Scaffold, Stack Integration & Core Infrastructure
12	- Story 1.2: Design Token System & Core Component Library
13	- Story 1.3: Account Creation and Login
14	- Story 1.4: Silent Session Refresh & Persistence
15	- Story 1.5: Expired-Session Recovery Overlay
16	- Story 1.6: Base Navigation Shell with Feature Placeholders
17	
18	## Requirements & Constraints
19	
20	- Account creation and login round-trip through the backend with exactly two fields (email, password) — no password confirmation, no display-name field at signup. Login/signup/refresh are the only calls using the anon key; every other call uses the user's access token.
21	- A valid, unexpired session must persist across app restarts with no re-prompt; nearing/past-expiry sessions refresh silently with no visible loading UI unless the call exceeds 300ms.
22	- When the backend reports an expired session, an overlay appears over whatever screen is active (never a navigation away); the underlying screen's state/scroll position is preserved; "Entrar novamente" leads to biometric/PIN re-auth, not a login form.
23	- All four base destinations (Home/Chat, side menu, Meus Registros, Configurações) must be reachable from launch; any destination whose feature isn't built yet shows a visually distinct, fully-polished placeholder — never a broken link and never a visibly "unfinished" look.
24	- Local UI interactions must respond in <100ms; any network call >300ms shows a loading indicator (manual timing spot-check, no automated perf tooling).
25	- Zero Clean Architecture layer violations: domain imports neither Flutter nor anything from a data layer.
26	- ≥80% domain-layer test coverage; the write-failure matrix (5 write endpoints × 3 failure types: timeout, malformed response, no connection = 15 scenarios) must be fully handled with zero unhandled exceptions — this epic builds the one shared, reusable test helper every later feature's write-endpoint tests reuse.
27	- Zero hardcoded visual values outside the design-tokens file; every control must honor Dynamic Type without truncating.
28	- An integration spike, before any other building, must prove `dio` + `flutter_secure_storage` + `get_it` work together in one bootstrap — this combination is otherwise unverified.
29	
30	## Technical Decisions
31	
32	- Single DI container: exactly one `get_it` instance registered at bootstrap; `dio` is configured through it; secrets (`FUNCTIONS_BASE_URL`, `SUPABASE_ANON_KEY`) load via `flutter_dotenv` from a gitignored `.env`, never hardcoded.
33	- One sealed `Failure` hierarchy, exactly 14 subtypes (13 from the backend's error taxonomy plus a local-only `MalformedResponse`), defined once and never redefined/subset per feature; every repository method returns `Future<Either<Failure, T>>` (or a `Stream` for SSE), with no native/dio exception ever escaping unmapped.
34	- One retry interceptor on the `dio`/`ApiClient` layer retries only the 6 server-marked `retryable:true` codes; every other failure surfaces once, unretried.
35	- One URL builder maps every operation to `{FUNCTIONS_BASE_URL}/<x-cerne-function>/<path-params>` (never the literal OpenAPI REST path); one interceptor owns headers — `apikey` on every call, anon-key bearer token only on signup/login/refresh, user access token on everything else.
36	- Exactly one `SessionStatus` stream is exposed from the auth feature's domain layer and registered once in DI as a singleton; every later consumer (including RF07/Epic 4) injects/listens to it rather than re-deriving session validity from a raw 401 or a second stream.
37	- This epic builds the `go_router` redirect skeleton composing session state; Epic 2 (RF03) later plugs a local vault-status gate into the same redirect, checked before session status — this epic should leave that composition point open rather than hardcoding a session-only redirect.
38	- Strict layer direction applies project-wide: only `data/` imports `dio`/`hive_ce`/platform plugins; `presentation/` never imports any feature's `data/` directly; a BLoC/Cubit constructor never takes another BLoC/Cubit as a dependency.
39	- Structural seed to scaffold: `lib/core/{design_tokens.dart, network/, failure/, di/, cache/, resource.dart, isolated_side_effect.dart, session/}` and `lib/features/{auth, vault, entries, capture, chat, export, dashboard, account}/`, each pre-wired for `data/domain/presentation`.
40	- Full stack is pinned (Flutter 3.47.x via `fvm`; `flutter_bloc`, `go_router`, `dio`, `hive_ce`, `get_it`, `fpdart`, `freezed`, `json_serializable`, `mocktail`, `fl_chart`, `local_auth`, `flutter_secure_storage`, `flutter_dotenv`, `whisper_ggml` — exact versions in the architecture spine's stack-pins table) and must resolve with no conflicts before anything else is built.
41	- Design tokens (`colors`, `typography`, `rounded`, `spacing`, `components`, plus the two elevation constants) are implemented verbatim, camelCase, as the single source of truth; every other file reads from them, never redefines a value.
42	
43	## UX & Interaction Patterns
44	
45	- Single fixed frame: 390×844 logical points, portrait only, light mode only — no breakpoint, landscape, or dark-mode path anywhere in the app.
46	- Buttons and text fields come from one shared component set: disabled buttons always render `colorBorder` background + `colorTextSecondary` text (never dimmed opacity); text fields show distinct default/focused(`colorPrimary`, 1.5px)/error(`colorError`) border states.
47	- The side menu is the sole navigation hub (plus back arrows and sheet "x" closes) — no drawer-within-drawer, no tab bar. It must resolve all four destinations (chat session switching, Meus Registros, Configurações, Planos de Ação) without a 404 or crash.
48	- The Planos de Ação placeholder (an explicit, never-implemented extension feature) must still look fully finished — same visual polish as real screens, no graying-out, no backend calls, no drag/drop logic.
49	- The avatar component (solid `colorPrimary` circle, 1–2 uppercase initials, 40px) is built here for reuse, not reimplementation, when Configurações needs its 52px variant later (Epic 8).
50	- The "Sessão expirada" overlay is a scrim over the current screen using the confirmation-dialog component with a neutral (`colorTextPrimary`) title — never the red destructive-title variant. It traps focus until dismissed/actioned, is the only overlay allowed on screen at a time (never stacks on another open overlay), and its entrance uses only the `scrimIn` (0.18s) choreography — no other motion exists in the system besides `sheetUp` for bottom sheets.
51	- Copy for the overlay must avoid any language implying data loss or starting over; history and scroll position are understood by the user to be preserved.
52	
53	## Cross-Story Dependencies
54	
55	- Story 1.1 (DI, API client, Failure hierarchy, URL builder, retry interceptor, shared failure-matrix test helper) is a hard prerequisite for every other story in this epic and for every later epic's write-endpoint tests.
56	- Story 1.2's design tokens and base components (buttons, text fields, avatar) are consumed by Story 1.3's login/signup screen, Story 1.5's overlay, and Story 1.6's navigation shell/placeholders.
57	- Story 1.4 depends on Story 1.3's auth calls and exposes the singleton `SessionStatus` stream that Story 1.5 listens to and that the `go_router` redirect skeleton composes.
58	- Story 1.5's "Entrar novamente" action routes to the biometric/PIN re-auth flow that is not built until Epic 2 — this epic should wire the route target without implementing that flow.
59	- Story 1.6's `go_router` redirect skeleton is extended by Epic 2 (RF03), which plugs in the local vault-status gate ahead of the session gate already built here, in a fixed order (vault checked first).
60	- Story 1.6's avatar component and placeholder-styling pattern are reused as-is by Epic 8 (Configurações' 52px avatar, other placeholder surfaces).

1	# Cerne — Prototype extract
2	
3	The visual reference of the product is `cerne-prototype.html` (this folder). Open it in a browser; it needs JavaScript. This extract lists its navigable states, its visual tokens, its components and the implementation notes that come with it.
4	
5	- **Frame:** 390 × 844 logical points, portrait only, 4 dp grid.
6	- **Language of the interface:** Portuguese. Every UI text below appears exactly as in the prototype, in quotes.
7	- **Precedence:** the prototype defines appearance and states. Behavior rules (triggers, timings, filters, error handling) are defined in `docs/input/requirements.md`; where the prototype's simulated behavior differs from a requirement, the requirement prevails.
8	
9	---
10	
11	## 1. Navigation map
12	
13	The prototype has **32 navigable states**, reachable from a single state machine (a `screen` variable plus overlay flags). Not every state is a new full screen — several are **overlays** (modal, sheet, bottom sheet, dialog) shown on top of one of three base screens: **Home/Chat**, **Meus Registros** and **Configurações**. Overlays preserve the screen underneath (it stays visible, with a darkened scrim behind).
14	
15	```
16	Splash (auto, 1.8 s)
17	  └─> Biometria ──tap/error──> PIN inicial / PIN após falha
18	  │      └─> "usar e-mail e senha" ──> Entrar / criar conta (toggle)
19	  │                                          └─> submit ──> Home/Chat
20	  └─(PIN complete, 4 digits)──> Home/Chat
21	  └─(Face ID/Touch ID ok)──> Home/Chat
22	
23	Home/Chat (base screen)
24	  ├─ overlay: Sessão expirada (backend session expires; "Entrar novamente" ──> Biometria)
25	  ├─ overlay: side menu (☰ icon) ──> Meus Registros | Planos de Ação | Configurações | new conversation
26	  └─ overlay: Insertion modal ("+" button) ──> tabs Texto / Áudio / Foto, each with its own sub-states
27	        (on save, the modal closes and returns to Home/Chat with the record added)
28	
29	Meus Registros (base screen, from the side menu)
30	  ├─ empty state (no records) ──CTA "Criar primeiro registro"──> Insertion modal
31	  ├─ overlay: filter sheet ──"Aplicar"──> active filters (chips on the list)
32	  └─ overlay: export card (download icon) ──> pending ──> processing ──> done | error | empty period
33	
34	Planos de Ação (base screen, from the side menu) — static screen, 3-column kanban (extension, not implemented)
35	
36	Configurações (base screen, from the side menu)
37	  ├─ dashboard variations: zero entries | one entry | more than 30 (with narrative) | narrative unavailable
38	  ├─ inline profile-name editing
39	  ├─ AI persona selection (Analítico / Empático / Socrático) (extension, not implemented)
40	  ├─ "Sair" ──> Biometria
41	  └─ overlay: account-deletion confirmation ──"Apagar tudo"──> Biometria (same destination as logout)
42	```
43	
44	---
45	
46	## 2. Navigable states
47	
48	Names as they appear in the prototype. The prototype's own state catalog has 32 entries: Tela 0 — Splash; Tela 0.1 — Biometria; Tela 0.1a — Entrar / criar conta; Tela 0.1b — PIN inicial; Tela 0.1c — PIN após falha; Tela 1 — Home / Chat; Tela 2 — Texto, Áudio (Gravando, Processando, Transcrito, Erro), Foto (Captura, Processando OCR, Reconhecido, Erro); Tela 3 — Menu lateral; Tela 1 — Sessão expirada; Tela 4 — Meus Registros, Estado vazio, Sheet de filtro, Filtros ativos; Exportar — Pendente, Processando, Concluído, Erro, Período vazio; Tela 5 — Planos de Ação **[ext]**; Tela 6 — Configurações, Dashboard zero entradas, Dashboard uma entrada, Narrativa indisponível, Confirmar exclusão. The tables below group them by screen; some rows describe variations inside one state (e.g., the bookmark sub-states, the streaming response). Extension states (requirements, section 2) are marked **[ext]**.
49	
50	### 2.1 Entry and authentication
51	| State | What it shows |
52	|---|---|
53	| Tela 0 — Splash | Wordmark "Cerne" centered on dark green, 3 loading dots; lasts 1.8 s and moves on automatically. |
54	| Tela 0.1 — Biometria | Fingerprint circle, title "Toque para desbloquear", link "Usar PIN", secondary link "usar e-mail e senha" near the bottom. |
55	| Tela 0.1a — Entrar | Login mode: title "Bem-vindo de volta", fields E-mail and Senha, CTA "Entrar", toggle link, link "usar biometria". |
56	| Tela 0.1a — Criar conta | Same screen in sign-up mode: title "Crie sua conta", CTA "Criar conta" (toggled by a text link, not a separate screen). |
57	| Tela 0.1b — PIN inicial | Title "Digite seu PIN", 4 progress dots, 3×4 numeric keypad with backspace; after the 4th digit, moves on after 350 ms. |
58	| Tela 0.1c — PIN após falha | Same as 0.1b plus the error band "Não foi possível reconhecer — digite seu PIN". |
59	
60	### 2.2 Conversation
61	| State | What it shows |
62	|---|---|
63	| Tela 1 — Home/Chat (default) | Messages going back and forth; dark green fixed header with ☰ and wordmark; composer with "+", placeholder "Escreva uma mensagem...", send icon. |
64	| Tela 1 — Streaming | AI response revealed progressively with a pulsing cursor. |
65	| Tela 1 — Insight | Insight card with ochre spine, label "INSIGHT", "x" to dismiss, interleaved in the messages. |
66	| Tela 1 — Falha ao gerar resposta | Incomplete AI message with "Falha ao gerar resposta — toque para tentar novamente" in red, in place of the time. |
67	| Tela 1 — Bookmark | Bookmark on each user message with 4 sub-states: `idle`, `saving` (spinner), `saved` (ochre check), `error` (red warning). |
68	| Tela 1 — Offline | Blue-gray banner "Sem conexão — histórico disponível, novas mensagens bloqueadas"; send icon disabled. |
69	| Tela 1 — Sessão expirada | Light scrim over the chat (still readable), centered card with lock icon, title "Sessão expirada", text saying history and scroll position are kept, button "Entrar novamente". |
70	| Tela 3 — Menu lateral | Drawer: initials avatar and name; section "CONVERSAS" with past sessions (title + timestamp); items "Meus Registros", "Planos de Ação", "Configurações"; new-conversation action. |
71	
72	### 2.3 Insertion modal (bottom sheet over Home/Chat; 9 states)
73	Common structure: "x" to close and a 3-tab bar (Texto / Áudio / Foto); the active tab has a filled dark-green background.
74	
75	| State | What it shows |
76	|---|---|
77	| Texto | Multiline field, placeholder "Escreva livremente...", button "Salvar". |
78	| Áudio — Gravando | Red stop button, animated 12-bar waveform, monospace timer (e.g., "00:12"). |
79	| Áudio — Processando | Spinner in place of stop; frozen, faded waveform (opacity .35); text "Transcrevendo..."; label "00:42 de áudio". |

187	- **Asynchronous processing — audio transcription:** a loading state (spinner + frozen waveform) and two outcomes (success/error); the error always offers "Tentar novamente" and never loses the recorded audio.

Consider this when designing navigation.
197	2. **Account deletion without a success screen:** both "Sair" and "Apagar tudo" return to the Biometria screen; there is no "account deleted" or "you signed out" screen.

199	4. **Insertion modal when offline:** not represented.
200	5. **Switching tabs in the insertion modal:** opening the modal always resets every tab to `idle`/empty, but switching tabs *during* a modal session is not cleared automatically — the expected behavior (e.g., whether an ongoing recording is discarded on tab switch) is not defined by the prototype.
201	6. **Per-entry sync indicator:** the states "sincronizado / sincronizando / erro de sync" exist visually on the cards, but no explicit "retry sync" action is shown for the error state. The semantics of the badge are in `docs/input/backend/sync-badge.md`.
202	7. **Text search combined with filters:** the filter sheet and the text search are on the same screen, but the prototype does not show them acting together.

# Cerne — Prototype extract

The visual reference of the product is `cerne-prototype.html` (this folder). Open it in a browser; it needs JavaScript. This extract lists its navigable states, its visual tokens, its components and the implementation notes that come with it.

- **Frame:** 390 × 844 logical points, portrait only, 4 dp grid.
- **Language of the interface:** Portuguese. Every UI text below appears exactly as in the prototype, in quotes.
- **Precedence:** the prototype defines appearance and states. Behavior rules (triggers, timings, filters, error handling) are defined in `docs/input/requirements.md`; where the prototype's simulated behavior differs from a requirement, the requirement prevails.

---

## 1. Navigation map

The prototype has **32 navigable states**, reachable from a single state machine (a `screen` variable plus overlay flags). Not every state is a new full screen — several are **overlays** (modal, sheet, bottom sheet, dialog) shown on top of one of three base screens: **Home/Chat**, **Meus Registros** and **Configurações**. Overlays preserve the screen underneath (it stays visible, with a darkened scrim behind).

```
Splash (auto, 1.8 s)
  └─> Biometria ──tap/error──> PIN inicial / PIN após falha
  │      └─> "usar e-mail e senha" ──> Entrar / criar conta (toggle)
  │                                          └─> submit ──> Home/Chat
  └─(PIN complete, 4 digits)──> Home/Chat
  └─(Face ID/Touch ID ok)──> Home/Chat

Home/Chat (base screen)
  ├─ overlay: Sessão expirada (backend session expires; "Entrar novamente" ──> Biometria)
  ├─ overlay: side menu (☰ icon) ──> Meus Registros | Planos de Ação | Configurações | new conversation
  └─ overlay: Insertion modal ("+" button) ──> tabs Texto / Áudio / Foto, each with its own sub-states
        (on save, the modal closes and returns to Home/Chat with the record added)

Meus Registros (base screen, from the side menu)
  ├─ empty state (no records) ──CTA "Criar primeiro registro"──> Insertion modal
  ├─ overlay: filter sheet ──"Aplicar"──> active filters (chips on the list)
  └─ overlay: export card (download icon) ──> pending ──> processing ──> done | error | empty period

Planos de Ação (base screen, from the side menu) — static screen, 3-column kanban (extension, not implemented)

Configurações (base screen, from the side menu)
  ├─ dashboard variations: zero entries | one entry | more than 30 (with narrative) | narrative unavailable
  ├─ inline profile-name editing
  ├─ AI persona selection (Analítico / Empático / Socrático) (extension, not implemented)
  ├─ "Sair" ──> Biometria
  └─ overlay: account-deletion confirmation ──"Apagar tudo"──> Biometria (same destination as logout)
```

---

## 2. Navigable states

Names as they appear in the prototype. The prototype's own state catalog has 32 entries: Tela 0 — Splash; Tela 0.1 — Biometria; Tela 0.1a — Entrar / criar conta; Tela 0.1b — PIN inicial; Tela 0.1c — PIN após falha; Tela 1 — Home / Chat; Tela 2 — Texto, Áudio (Gravando, Processando, Transcrito, Erro), Foto (Captura, Processando OCR, Reconhecido, Erro); Tela 3 — Menu lateral; Tela 1 — Sessão expirada; Tela 4 — Meus Registros, Estado vazio, Sheet de filtro, Filtros ativos; Exportar — Pendente, Processando, Concluído, Erro, Período vazio; Tela 5 — Planos de Ação **[ext]**; Tela 6 — Configurações, Dashboard zero entradas, Dashboard uma entrada, Narrativa indisponível, Confirmar exclusão. The tables below group them by screen; some rows describe variations inside one state (e.g., the bookmark sub-states, the streaming response). Extension states (requirements, section 2) are marked **[ext]**.

### 2.1 Entry and authentication
| State | What it shows |
|---|---|
| Tela 0 — Splash | Wordmark "Cerne" centered on dark green, 3 loading dots; lasts 1.8 s and moves on automatically. |
| Tela 0.1 — Biometria | Fingerprint circle, title "Toque para desbloquear", link "Usar PIN", secondary link "usar e-mail e senha" near the bottom. |
| Tela 0.1a — Entrar | Login mode: title "Bem-vindo de volta", fields E-mail and Senha, CTA "Entrar", toggle link, link "usar biometria". |

| `textMonoCaption` | IBM Plex Mono 500 · 12/16 · letter-spacing .2 | Technical metadata (timestamps, counters, status labels) |

### Spacing (4 dp grid)
`spacingXs` 4 · `spacingSm` 8 · `spacingMd` 16 · `spacingLg` 24 · `spacingXl` 32 · `spacing2xl` 48 (dp).

### Radii
`radiusSm` 8 dp (inputs, chips) · `radiusMd` 16 dp (cards, bubbles) · `radiusLg` 24 dp (sheets, modals) · `radiusFull` 999 dp (avatars, pills).

### Elevation
`elevation1` — `0 1px 3px rgba(36,31,25,.08)` (cards at rest) · `elevation2` — `0 4px 16px rgba(36,31,25,.14)` (sheets, modals).

### Icons
Phosphor library, Regular style, 24 dp: `list`, `plus`, `magnifying-glass`, `funnel`, `bookmark-simple`, `microphone`, `camera`, `gear`, `kanban`, `notebook`, `fingerprint`, `lightbulb` (and others used on specific screens: `check`, `warning-circle`, `wifi-slash`, `circle-notch`, `caret-left`, `download-simple`, `pencil-simple`, `x`, `stop`, `image`, `check-circle`, `chart-line-up`, `backspace`, `lock-key`, `paper-plane-tilt`, `chat-circle-text`).

### Spine (colored bar on the left of a card) — 3 contexts
1. Proactive insight in the chat — ochre.
2. Entry origin in "Meus Registros" — color by type: manual = dark green, audio = olive green, photo = gray, chat = ochre.
3. Kanban column in "Planos de Ação" — color by column **[ext]**.

### Micro-animations and transitions
- `scrimIn` (0.18 s ease-out): fade of the darkened background when any overlay opens.
- `sheetUp` (0.2 s ease-out): bottom sheets (insertion modal, filter, export) rise from the bottom of the screen.
- Continuous spinner (`spin`, 1 s linear infinite) in every loading state.
- Text streaming: the AI response is revealed progressively, with a blinking cursor at the end while it is "typing".
- PIN: after the 4th digit, a 350 ms pause before navigating.

---

## 4. Special states that need extra care

- **Expired session:** an overlay on the chat that keeps history and scroll position — the expired token must not discard the conversation state in memory before re-authentication. Re-authenticating goes back to the Biometria screen, not to a full form.
- **Offline:** blocks **sending new messages** (send icon disabled, explanatory banner), but **history stays visible and navigable**. The prototype does not show what happens to the insertion modal (text/audio/photo) when offline.
- **Asynchronous processing — audio transcription:** a loading state (spinner + frozen waveform) and two outcomes (success/error); the error always offers "Tentar novamente" and never loses the recorded audio.
- **Asynchronous processing — photo OCR:** same pattern as audio, with one extra exit on error: "Salvar só a foto", which saves the record even without extracted text.
- **Asynchronous processing — export:** two loading stages (preparing → generating the AI summary) before the result; on error, the raw data is always available for download — the failure is isolated to the AI narrative, never to the user's data.
- **Dashboard narrative unavailable:** the chart loads normally but the AI summary paragraph fails — distinct from "zero entries" (lack of data) and needs its own error message.

---

## 5. Implementation notes

1. **"29 frames" vs. "32 states":** the prototype has 32 distinct navigable states, but the number of frames (29) suggests that some state families should be one screen with internal state, not separate routes (e.g., a single `ExportSheet` with a status enum instead of 5 routes). Consider this when designing navigation.
2. **Account deletion without a success screen:** both "Sair" and "Apagar tudo" return to the Biometria screen; there is no "account deleted" or "you signed out" screen.
3. **Login vs. sign-up:** the same screen toggled by a text link; the prototype shows no extra sign-up fields (e.g., password confirmation, name). Whether sign-up needs extra fields is a product decision not covered visually.
4. **Insertion modal when offline:** not represented.
5. **Switching tabs in the insertion modal:** opening the modal always resets every tab to `idle`/empty, but switching tabs *during* a modal session is not cleared automatically — the expected behavior (e.g., whether an ongoing recording is discarded on tab switch) is not defined by the prototype.
6. **Per-entry sync indicator:** the states "sincronizado / sincronizando / erro de sync" exist visually on the cards, but no explicit "retry sync" action is shown for the error state. The semantics of the badge are in `docs/input/backend/sync-badge.md`.
7. **Text search combined with filters:** the filter sheet and the text search are on the same screen, but the prototype does not show them acting together.

---

## 6. Component library

| Component | Where it appears | Variations |
|---|---|---|
| Primary button | Auth, modals, sheets, confirmations | normal (`#1F3D34`) · pressed (`#16281F`, darker) · disabled (`#E1DACB` background, `#6B6255` text) |
| Secondary button (outline) | "Tentar novamente", "Cancelar", "Baixar dados brutos" | `#1F3D34` outline, no fill |
| Text button (ghost) | Mode-toggle links, "Fechar", "Limpar" | no background, `#1F3D34` or `#6B6255` depending on context |
| Text field | Login, Texto tab, name editing | empty · focused (1.5px `#1F3D34` border) · error (`#B3402A` border) |
| Chat bubble | Home/Chat | user (light green, straight bottom-right corner) · AI (ivory with shadow, straight bottom-left corner) · streaming (pulsing cursor at the end of the text) |
| Insight card | Home/Chat | ochre spine, mono label "INSIGHT", dismiss button |
| Bookmark button (RF10) | User messages in the chat | idle (outline) · saving (spinner) · saved (ochre check) · error (red warning) |
| Send-error banner | Home/Chat | "Não foi possível enviar — toque para tentar novamente"; background `rgba(179,64,42,.08)`, warning icon, red text |
| Offline banner | Home/Chat | blue-gray background `#5C7A93`, `ph-wifi-slash` icon, light text |
| Sync badge | Record cards (Tela 4) | synced (green dot) · synchronizing (ochre dot) · sync error (red dot) |
| Filter chip | Filter sheet, active filters | single choice (date) · multiple choice (category, type) · removable with "x" (active filters) |
| Record card | Tela 4 | spine colored by origin (manual = dark green, audio = olive green, photo = gray, chat = ochre) |
| Kanban card **[ext]** | Planos de Ação | spine by column (to do / in progress / done) |
| Initials avatar | Side menu, Configurações | dark green circle, 1–2 uppercase initials, two sizes (40px in the menu, 52px in Configurações) |
| AI persona card **[ext]** | Configurações | not selected (thin border) · selected (thick `#1F3D34` border + check icon) |
| Bar chart (dashboard) | Configurações | populated (10 bars) · one bar · empty (placeholder icon) |
| Export status card | Tela 4 (bottom sheet) | pending · processing · done · error · empty |
| Confirmation dialog | Sessão expirada, Confirmar exclusão | background scrim + centered card; neutral title (session) or red title (destructive deletion) |
| PIN keypad | Tela 0.1b/c | digits 0–9 + backspace; progress dots above |
| Tab bar | Insertion modal | 3 tabs (Texto/Áudio/Foto), active tab with filled background |
| Audio waveform | Insertion modal, Áudio tab | active/animated (recording) · frozen and faded (processing) |
| Skeleton | Any content loaded over the network | shown for calls longer than 300 ms (RNF01) |

failed_layers: '' # set at runtime: comma-separated list of layers that failed or returned empty
---

# Step 2: Review

## RULES

- YOU MUST ALWAYS SPEAK OUTPUT in your Agent communication style with the config `{communication_language}`
- All review subagents must run at the same model capability as the current session.
- Run subagents synchronously: launch them together, then wait for all results before continuing.

## INSTRUCTIONS

1. The review layers are `{workflow.review_layers}`, resolved during activation.

2. For each layer in `{workflow.review_layers}`:
   - `instruction` empty or missing → drop the layer silently (an override disabled it).
   - `when` condition present and not satisfied by the current context (`{review_mode}`, `{spec_file}`) → drop the layer and tell the user, e.g. "Acceptance Auditor skipped — no spec file provided."
   - otherwise → the layer is active.

   If no layer is active, HALT with status `blocked` and blocking condition `no active review layers`.

3. Execute all active layers in parallel wherever their execution methods allow: expand `{skill-root}` in each layer's `instruction` to this skill's absolute installed directory, then substitute the runtime placeholders (`{diff_output}`, `{spec_file}`). For an instruction that launches a reviewer subagent, launch that child with the prompt text after placeholder substitution; do not load the reviewer instruction file yourself. For any other customized instruction, execute it as written. Do not leave `{skill-root}` unresolved in a child prompt. If a layer's instruction requires subagents and subagents are not available, for each such layer write under `{implementation_artifacts}` the exact child prompt from that layer's instruction after placeholder substitution (not a path-only pointer), then HALT. Ask the user to run each in a separate session (ideally a different LLM) and paste back the findings. When findings are pasted, treat them as those layers' findings and resume from this point. This is the only allowed parent-side read of a reviewer instruction file.

4. **Layer failure handling**: If any layer fails, times out, or returns empty results, append the layer's `name` to `{failed_layers}` (comma-separated) and proceed with findings from the remaining layers.

5. Collect all findings from the completed layers, keeping track of each finding's originating layer `id`.

## NEXT

Read fully and follow `./step-03-triage.md`

255	+/// `/configuracoes`"). Named constants so no call site retypes a path
256	+/// literal that could drift from the one `GoRouter` below.
257	+abstract final class AppRoutePaths {
258	+  static const boot = '/boot';
259	+  static const auth = '/auth';
260	+  static const reauth = '/reauth';
261	+  static const home = '/';
262	+  static const meusRegistros = '/meus-registros';

268	+/// competing `redirect`") — composes only [SessionRepository.currentStatus]

277	+/// `GoRouter`'s internal `routerDelegate` (not part of its public API).
278	+GoRouter buildAppRouter({
279	+  required SessionRepository sessionRepository,
280	+  required GlobalKey<NavigatorState> navigatorKey,
281	+}) {
282	+  return GoRouter(
283	+    navigatorKey: navigatorKey,
284	+    initialLocation: AppRoutePaths.boot,
285	+    refreshListenable: _GoRouterRefreshStream(sessionRepository.statusStream),
286	+    redirect: (context, state) => _redirect(sessionRepository, state),

291	+      ),
292	+      GoRoute(
293	+        path: AppRoutePaths.auth,
294	+        builder: (context, state) => AuthScreen(
295	+          cubit: sl<AuthCubit>(),
296	+          onAuthenticated: (context) => context.go(AppRoutePaths.home),
297	+        ),
298	+      ),
299	+      GoRoute(
300	+        path: AppRoutePaths.reauth,
301	+        builder: (context, state) => const BiometricReauthPlaceholderScreen(),
302	+      ),
303	+      GoRoute(
304	+        path: AppRoutePaths.home,
305	+        builder: (context, state) => const HomeChatPlaceholderScreen(),
306	+      ),
307	+      GoRoute(
308	+        path: AppRoutePaths.meusRegistros,
309	+        builder: (context, state) => const MeusRegistrosPlaceholderScreen(),
310	+      ),
311	+      GoRoute(
312	+        path: AppRoutePaths.planosDeAcao,
313	+        builder: (context, state) => const ActionPlansPlaceholderScreen(),
314	+      ),
315	+      GoRoute(
316	+        path: AppRoutePaths.configuracoes,
317	+        builder: (context, state) => const ConfiguracoesPlaceholderScreen(),
318	+      ),
319	+    ],

323	+/// I/O & Edge-Case Matrix:
324	+/// - status not yet known (`null`) -> `/boot`, unless already there.
325	+/// - `unauthenticated` -> `/auth`, unless already there.
326	+/// - `authenticated`/`expired` -> leaves `/boot`/`/auth` for `/`; every
327	+///   other location (including `/reauth`, reached only by the expiry
328	+///   overlay's own explicit navigation) is left alone — a mid-session
329	+///   expiry never navigates away (Story 1.5 behavior preserved), and the
330	+///   three non-Home destinations stay reachable while `expired`.
331	+///
332	+/// AD-14 seam: Epic 2 (RF03) plugs a local `VaultStatus` gate in here,
333	+/// checked *before* this session check (Cross-Story Dependencies: "vault
334	+/// checked first") — e.g. `if (vaultStatus == VaultStatus.locked) return
335	+/// AppRoutePaths.vaultLock;` ahead of the block below. Nothing here should
336	+/// assume session validity alone ever decides access once that lands.
337	+String? _redirect(SessionRepository sessionRepository, GoRouterState state) {
338	+  final status = sessionRepository.currentStatus;
339	+  final location = state.matchedLocation;
340	+
341	+  if (status == null) {
342	+    return location == AppRoutePaths.boot ? null : AppRoutePaths.boot;
343	+  }
344	+
345	+  if (status == SessionStatus.unauthenticated) {
346	+    return location == AppRoutePaths.auth ? null : AppRoutePaths.auth;
347	+  }
348	+
349	+  // status is authenticated or expired.
350	+  if (location == AppRoutePaths.boot || location == AppRoutePaths.auth) {
351	+    return AppRoutePaths.home;
352	+  }
353	+  return null;
354	+}

441	+  // Same two one-shot guards `main.dart` used to own (code review of
442	+  // story-1-5): `_expiryOverlayShown` is a per-episode latch (nothing
443	+  // today transitions `SessionStatus` back out of `expired`, so without
444	+  // it a later event on this same subscription would reopen the overlay
445	+  // on top of wherever the user already navigated after confirming it);
446	+  // `_reauthRouteRequested` guards the dialog's own confirm callback

448	+  bool _expiryOverlayShown = false;
449	+  bool _reauthRouteRequested = false;

451	+  @override

457	+      // current implementation ever errors on this stream, but a future
458	+      // one that did must not surface as an unhandled zone exception.

482	+      // (see class doc) — `showGeneralDialog` needs a context *below* it,
483	+      // which `NavigatorState.overlay`'s own context always is.
484	+      final overlayContext = widget.navigatorKey.currentState?.overlay?.context;
485	+      if (overlayContext == null) {
486	+        // Navigator not mounted yet — nothing to show an overlay over.
487	+        _expiryOverlayShown = false;
488	+        return;
489	+      }
490	+      unawaited(
491	+        ConfirmationDialog.show(
492	+          context: overlayContext,
493	+          builder: (dialogContext) => ConfirmationDialog(
494	+            icon: Icons.lock_outline,
495	+            title: 'Sessão expirada',
496	+            message:

498	+                'continuar — sua conversa continua aqui.',
499	+            caption: 'o histórico e a posição do scroll são preservados',
500	+            confirmLabel: 'Entrar novamente',
501	+            barrierColor: DesignTokens.colorScrim,
502	+            onConfirm: () {
503	+              if (_reauthRouteRequested) {
504	+                return;
505	+              }
506	+              _reauthRouteRequested = true;
507	+              if (dialogContext.mounted) {

509	+              }
510	+              widget.router.go(AppRoutePaths.reauth);
511	+            },
512	+          ),
513	+        ),
514	+      );
515	+    });
516	+  }

  - **Demonstration:** Reverting `toggleMode` to the old raw `AuthState(mode:, email:, password:)` constructor would again silently reset `status` to idle on every toggle, including mid-submit. The existing test would still pass unchanged, because it never exercises a non-idle `status` before calling `toggleMode`.

(Note: today's `AuthScreen` already disables the toggle link while `isSubmitting` — `lib/features/auth/presentation/screens/auth_screen.dart:158` — so this specific path isn't reachable through the current UI; the gap is in the cubit's own public contract, which the comment explicitly documents as a guarantee.)
  - **Suggested test shape:** Drive the cubit into `ResourceLoading` (e.g. via an unresolved `Future` from a mocked repository call), call `toggleMode()`, and assert `cubit.state.status` is still `ResourceLoading`, not reset to `ResourceIdle`.
  
  ### `ExpiryOverlayHost`'s double-tap guard on "Entrar novamente" has no test exercising two taps before the dialog closes
  
  - **Changed surface:** `lib/core/navigation/expiry_overlay_host.dart:61-64,117-130` (new file). `_reauthRouteRequested` is a new one-shot guard: `onConfirm` checks `if (_reauthRouteRequested) { return; }` before setting the flag, popping the dialog, and calling `widget.router.go(AppRoutePaths.reauth)`. The comment (`:61-64`) explains it exists "against a rapid double-tap during its 180ms exit fade."
  - **Impacted consumer or site:** The confirm button inside `ConfirmationDialog`, built via `AppButton` (`lib/core/widgets/app_button.dart`). I read `AppButton` and `ConfirmationDialog` (both unchanged, out of this diff) and confirmed neither disables itself after a single tap — `AppButton.onPressed` stays the same callback for the button's whole lifetime, and `ConfirmationDialog.show`'s 180ms fade-out (`lib/core/widgets/confirmation_dialog.dart:85`) leaves the button mounted and tappable during that window. `_reauthRouteRequested` is therefore the only thing preventing a second tap from running `onConfirm` twice.
  - **Existing test evidence:** I searched `test/main_test.dart` and `test/core/navigation/expiry_overlay_host_test.dart` for `_reauthRouteRequested`, "double-tap", and every call site of `tester.tap(find.text('Entrar novamente'))` (`main_test.dart:335,362`). Both call sites tap exactly once and then `pumpAndSettle()` before any further assertion — neither test taps twice in the same frame/before the exit animation settles.
  - **Missing verification:** An assertion that tapping "Entrar novamente" twice in quick succession (before `pumpAndSettle`) calls `Navigator.of(dialogContext).pop()` and `router.go(AppRoutePaths.reauth)` only once, and does not throw.

Neither existing test would fail, since both only tap once.
  - **Consequence:** A regression removing this guard would ship a double-tap crash/duplicate-navigation path undetected by the current suite.
  - **Suggested test shape:** In `expiry_overlay_host_test.dart` or `main_test.dart`, after the dialog is showing, call `tester.tap(find.text('Entrar novamente'))` twice back-to-back with only `tester.pump()` (not `pumpAndSettle`) between them, then assert `tester.takeException()` is `isNull` and the router ends up at `/reauth` exactly once.

# Step 3: Triage

## RULES

- YOU MUST ALWAYS SPEAK OUTPUT in your Agent communication style with the config `{communication_language}`

## INSTRUCTIONS

1. **Normalize** findings from all layers into a unified list where each finding has:
   - `id` -- sequential integer
   - `source` -- the `id` of the layer that produced the finding (e.g., `blind-hunter`), or merged sources joined with `+` (e.g., `blind-hunter+edge-case-hunter`)
   - `title` -- one-line summary
   - `detail` -- full description
   - `location` -- file and line reference (if available)

2. **Deduplicate.** Deduplicate only findings with the same claim and same required action. If two or more findings meet both conditions, merge them into one:
   - Use the most specific finding as the base (prefer findings with a precise location over prose-only findings).
   - Append any unique detail, reasoning, or location references from the other finding(s) into the surviving `detail` field.
   - Set `source` to the merged sources (e.g., `blind-hunter+edge-case-hunter`).

3. Then evaluate each remaining finding independently. Do not reject a finding because a related finding was rejected.

4. **Read the code before rating.** Before assigning severity, open the source at each finding's location and read enough surrounding code to judge reachability -- call sites, guards, and validation that live outside the diff hunk. Do not rate from the diff hunk alone. Severity reflects the real consequence at a real call site, not the worst theoretical reading.

5. **Assign severity** to each finding by consequence for the artifact's main consumer (software user, document reader, etc).
   Disregard any severity assigned by a reviewing subagent. Review subagents operate under by-design information asymmetry and do not have enough context to set final severity for this workflow.
   - `low` -- none or cosmetic
   - `medium` -- tolerable
   - `high` -- intolerable

6. **Route** each finding into exactly one triage bucket:
   - **decision_needed** -- There is an ambiguous choice that requires human input. The code cannot be correctly patched without knowing the user's intent. Only possible if `{review_mode}` = `"full"`.
   - **patch** -- Code issue that is fixable without human input. The correct fix is unambiguous.
   - **defer** -- Pre-existing issue not caused by the current change. Real but not actionable now.
   - **dismiss** -- Noise, false positive, or handled elsewhere.

   If `{review_mode}` = `"no-spec"` and a finding would otherwise be `decision_needed`, reclassify it as `patch` (if the fix is unambiguous) or `defer` (if not).

7. **Drop** all `dismiss` findings. Record the dismiss count for the summary.

8. If `{failed_layers}` is non-empty, report which layers failed before announcing results. If zero findings remain after dropping dismissed AND `{failed_layers}` is non-empty, warn the user that the review may be incomplete rather than announcing a clean review.

9. If zero findings remain after triage (all rejected or none raised): state "✅ Clean review — all layers passed." (Step 3 already warned if any review layers failed via `{failed_layers}`.)

## NEXT

Read fully and follow `./step-04-present.md`

54	  void passwordChanged(String value) {
55	    emit(
56	      state.copyWith(
57	        password: value,
58	        clearEmailError: true,
59	        clearPasswordError: true,
60	        clearFormError: true,
61	      ),
62	    );
63	  }
64	
65	  /// Validates locally first — a malformed email (or empty password) blocks
66	  /// submit *before* any round trip (epics.md Story 1.3 AC), each as its own
67	  /// single-field error so only the offending field is ever bordered. Only
68	  /// once local validation passes does it call `auth-signup`/`auth-login`
69	  /// with exactly `{email, password}` (the e-mail trimmed — stray
70	  /// leading/trailing whitespace must never reach the backend and risk a
71	  /// spurious `AUTH_INVALID`), saving the access token (via the repository)
72	  /// before this resolves.
73	  Future<void> submit() async {
74	    if (state.isSubmitting) {
75	      return;
76	    }
77	
78	    final emailError = validateEmail(state.email);
79	    if (emailError != null) {
80	      emit(
81	        state.copyWith(
82	          emailError: emailError,
83	          clearPasswordError: true,
84	          clearFormError: true,
85	        ),
86	      );
87	      return;
88	    }
89	
90	    final passwordError = validatePassword(state.password);
91	    if (passwordError != null) {
92	      emit(
93	        state.copyWith(
94	          passwordError: passwordError,
95	          clearEmailError: true,
96	          clearFormError: true,
97	        ),
98	      );
99	      return;
100	    }
101	
102	    emit(
103	      state.copyWith(
104	        status: const ResourceLoading<Unit>(),
105	        clearEmailError: true,
106	        clearPasswordError: true,
107	        clearFormError: true,
108	      ),
109	    );
110	
111	    final trimmedEmail = state.email.trim();
112	    final result = state.mode == AuthMode.login
113	        ? await _authRepository.logIn(
114	            email: trimmedEmail,
115	            password: state.password,
116	          )
117	        : await _authRepository.signUp(
118	            email: trimmedEmail,
119	            password: state.password,
120	          );
121	
122	    result.match(
123	      (failure) => emit(
124	        state.copyWith(
125	          status: const ResourceIdle<Unit>(),
126	          formError: failure.message,
127	        ),
128	      ),
129	      // Clears the typed password once it's done its job — the access
130	      // token is already persisted by now, so there's no reason for the
131	      // plaintext value to keep sitting in this (DI-singleton, long-lived)
132	      // cubit's state after success. `markAuthenticated()` runs first
133	      // (Story 1.6 boundary) so the `go_router` redirect already sees
134	      // `authenticated` by the time this emission's `BlocListener` fires
135	      // `onAuthenticated`'s own navigation.
136	      (_) {
137	        _sessionRepository.markAuthenticated();
138	        emit(
139	          state.copyWith(status: const ResourceData<Unit>(unit), password: ''),
140	        );
141	      },
142	    );
143	  }
144	}

  summary: `main.dart`'s `_expiryOverlayShown` is set to `true` before confirming `ConfirmationDialog.show()` actually presented anything — if `show()` silently no-ops because `ConfirmationDialog.isOpen` is already held by a different consumer, the session-expiry overlay never appears and the flag is never reset, leaving the user stuck in `expired` with no visible recovery.
  evidence: Unreachable today — `ConfirmationDialog` has exactly one call site in the whole app (this story's own overlay), so `isOpen` can never already be `true` from an unrelated caller when `_maybeShowExpiryOverlay` runs. Becomes reachable the moment a second consumer is added (the widget's own doc comment names Epic 8's account-deletion confirm as that future consumer, reusing the same static `isOpen` guard) — revisit there rather than speculatively guarding against a caller that doesn't exist yet.

- source_spec: `_bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/spec-1-6-base-navigation-shell-with-feature-placeholders.md`
  summary: The side menu's drawer header shows a generic avatar/label instead of the real logged-in user's identity (initials/email), even though the prototype's `Tela 3 — Menu lateral` block shows `{{ profileInitials }}`/`{{ profileName }}`.
  evidence: No display name exists anywhere yet (Epic 8 introduces `displayName`), and the only identity the backend ever returns — the login/signup response's `email` — is never persisted anywhere today, so it doesn't survive a silent-refresh restart. Building that (new `AccessTokenProvider.saveUserEmail`/`readUserEmail`, a `SessionRepository.currentUserEmail` accessor, and `AuthRepositoryImpl` wiring) pushed this story's spec well past its token budget (≈2.5k vs. the 900-1600 target) alongside the go_router shell itself, which is the story's actual goal. Carved off rather than folded in; revisit once Epic 8's `displayName` exists, or sooner if a real identity in the drawer is wanted before then — the generic header is still fully polished (not grayed-out/broken), satisfying this story's own acceptance bar.

  evidence: Intentional per the prototype and this story's own boundaries ("no drawer-within-drawer," side menu is the sole hub reached only from Home) — not a bug today, just an unguarded invariant. # Test Automation Summary

## Context

Cerne has no device/simulator or CI pipeline yet (AGENTS.md), so a true
platform-level E2E (`integration_test` on a real/simulated device) isn't
viable right now. The project already substitutes composition-root widget
tests — `CerneApp` pumped with only a single named boundary faked (the
`AuthRepository`/`SessionRepository` interface, or, in
`network_pipeline_integration_test.dart`, the `HttpClientAdapter`) — as its
E2E equivalent. `ApiClient`'s own docstring states the convention
explicitly: tests mock `ApiClient` directly; only one dedicated suite is
allowed to fake the transport boundary beneath it. All API-level coverage
(status codes, response mapping, the 3-error write-failure matrix per
write endpoint, retry behavior, header/URL building) already exists across
`test/core/network/` and `test/features/auth/data/`.

Before adding anything, the full suite was run: **194/194 tests passing**,
`flutter analyze`: **0 issues**. Given that density, the only legitimate
gap found was in the composition-root (E2E-equivalent) layer.

## Generated Tests

### E2E Tests (composition-root, `test/main_test.dart`)

- [x] `test/main_test.dart` — **new**: "CerneApp resolves the real AuthCubit
  and navigates to the post-auth placeholder once signup succeeds" —
  mirrors the existing real-wiring login test, but drives the
  toggle-to-signup path. Previously, signup was only exercised against a
  directly-constructed `AuthScreen`/`AuthCubit` pair
  (`auth_screen_test.dart`), never through `main.dart`'s actual
  `sl<AuthCubit>()` resolution and `onAuthenticated` → `Navigator`
  wiring — only the login path had that proof.

No other E2E or API gaps were found; everything else implemented so far
(design tokens/component library, auth validators, auth cubit, auth
repository/data source, session repository, network pipeline, DI bootstrap)
already has dedicated coverage at the appropriate layer.

## Coverage

- Composition-root E2E scenarios: login ✅, **signup ✅ (added)**,
  authenticated-boot ✅, unauthenticated-boot ✅, boot-loading-threshold ✅
- API/data-source coverage: auth-login, auth-signup, auth-refresh — happy
  path + the full 3-case write-failure matrix (timeout/malformed/offline)
  each, plus retry and non-retry behavior proven over a faked transport
- Implemented feature scope (per `sprint-status.yaml`): stories 1.1–1.4
  (scaffold, design tokens, auth, session refresh) — all covered. Stories
  1.5+ are still `backlog`, so out of scope for this pass.

## Verification

- `fvm flutter test` → 195/195 passing (194 pre-existing + 1 new)
- `fvm flutter analyze` → 0 issues

## Next Steps

- Revisit the "no device/CI" constraint (AGENTS.md) once a simulator or CI
  step exists — at that point, a real `integration_test` driver test
  becomes possible and composition-root tests can be retired in its favor.
- Re-run this pass after each future story (1.6 navigation shell, …) lands,
  since each adds a new composition-root surface worth the same
  login/signup-style proof.

---

# Story 1.5 — Expired-Session Recovery Overlay

## Context

Story 1.5 adds a new core port (`SessionExpiryNotifier`), a third
`SessionStatus` value (`expired`), a new shared `ConfirmationDialog`
overlay widget, and `main.dart`'s reaction to the two together. Each new
unit gets its own isolated test, and the composition-root suite
(`test/main_test.dart`) gets the end-to-end proof that a mid-session
`AUTH_EXPIRED` actually surfaces the overlay over the live screen and
routes on confirm — same E2E-equivalent pattern this file's Story 1.4
section established.

Code review of this story's own diff surfaced and fixed four gaps before
landing: a rebuild that could reopen an already-dismissed overlay (no
guard against calling `show()` more than once per `expired` episode), the
system back gesture being able to dismiss the overlay despite the
non-dismissible-barrier requirement (`PopScope` was missing), a synchronous
`showGeneralDialog` failure permanently locking the single-overlay guard,
and a stored-but-empty refresh token not short-circuiting
`restoreSession()` the same way a `null` one does.

## Generated Tests

### Unit (new core/feature code)

- [x] `test/core/session/session_expiry_notifier_test.dart` — **new**:
  `SessionExpiryNotifierImpl.notifyExpired()`/`expiredEvents`/`dispose()`.
- [x] `test/features/auth/data/repositories/session_repository_impl_test.dart`
  — **extended**: the `expired` bridge's whole I/O matrix (mid-session
  expiry while authenticated, while unauthenticated, before any status
  yet, a second event while already `expired`, `dispose()` cancelling the
  subscription), plus a stored-but-empty refresh token now being treated
  as "no session" the same as `null`.
- [x] `test/core/network/api_client_test.dart` — **extended**: the
  notifier fires only for a mid-session `AUTH_EXPIRED` outside
  `anonKeyOnlyFunctions`.
- [x] `test/core/network/network_pipeline_integration_test.dart` —
  **extended**: an `AUTH_EXPIRED` response on a bearer call reaches the
  notifier through the real wiring, not just the mocked `ApiClient` unit.

### Composition/interaction (shared widget)

- [x] `test/core/widgets/confirmation_dialog_test.dart` — **new**: neutral
  vs. destructive `titleColor`, the non-dismissible scrim (including a
  dedicated check that the tap is actually absorbed by the barrier rather
  than just leaving the dialog on screen), the back-gesture `PopScope`
  guard, the single-overlay guard, `onConfirm` firing, focus staying
  trapped on the dialog under Tab traversal, and no overflow at 3.0x
  Dynamic Type.

### E2E Tests (composition-root, `test/main_test.dart`)

- [x] `test/main_test.dart` — **extended**, new "Story 1.5" group: the
  overlay appearing over the still-mounted authenticated screen, a second
  `expired` emission never stacking a second dialog, "Entrar novamente"
  dismissing the overlay and routing to the biometric/PIN placeholder, and
  a later rebuild while `statusStream` is still `expired` (simulated by
  pumping the same `CerneApp` root again) not reopening an
  already-confirmed overlay.

## Coverage

- Composition-root E2E scenarios: mid-session expiry overlay ✅, no
  second overlay on a repeat event ✅, confirm-and-route ✅, no reopen on
  an unrelated rebuild ✅ (added)
- Core/unit coverage: `SessionExpiryNotifier`, the `expired` bridge's full
  I/O matrix, `ConfirmationDialog`'s accessibility/dismissal guarantees —
  all covered at the layer where coverage is cheapest and clearest.
- Implemented feature scope (per `sprint-status.yaml`): stories 1.1–1.5 —
  all covered. Story 1.6 is still `backlog`, so out of scope for this pass.

## Verification

- `fvm flutter test` → 223/223 passing
- `fvm flutter analyze` → 0 issues

## Next Steps

- When Story 1.6 (base navigation shell) replaces `main.dart`'s
  `MaterialApp`/`Navigator` shape with `go_router`, re-home this story's
  composition-root assertions onto whatever replaces `_CerneAppState`.
- Epic 2's real biometric/PIN re-auth flow is the first thing that will
  need to transition `SessionStatus` back out of `expired` — extend this
  story's bridge coverage there rather than re-deriving it (tracked in
  `deferred-work.md`).

---
